agency: U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Accountability
title: Hearing: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena - Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency (House Oversight, 26 Jul 2023)
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of a House Oversight Committee hearing held on July 26, 2023, regarding Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP).

incidents.summary: F-18 pilot reports detecting unknown objects in airspace off Virginia Beach after radar upgrades.
incidents.quote: After upgrades were made to our jet’s radar systems, we began detecting unknown objects operating in our airspace.
incidents.shape: cube inside of a clear sphere

incidents.summary: Two F-18 Super Hornets encountered a UAP 10 miles off the coast of Virginia Beach.
incidents.quote: The object, described as a dark gray or a black cube inside of a clear sphere, came within 50 feet of the lead aircraft
incidents.shape: cube inside of a clear sphere

incidents.summary: Tic Tac UAP encounter by USS Nimitz Carrier Airwing 11.
incidents.location_name: Off the coast of San Diego
incidents.quote: All four of us... looked down and saw a white Tic Tac object with a longitudinal axis pointing north south

incidents.summary: Boeing contractors observed a large red square object hovering over a launch facility.
incidents.quote: observed a very large 100-yard sighted red square approach the base from the ocean and hover at low altitude

incidents.summary: Diamond formation UAP encounter over the Gulf of Mexico.
incidents.quote: They saw a sequence of four craft in a clear diamond formation
